title: Built for labour law consultants who manage compliance for multiple businesses.
description: Whether you work independently or as part of a growing consultancy, LabourFlow helps you manage clients, compliance, payroll, documents and team operations from one platform.

items.title: Labour Law Consultants
items.description: Manage multiple client companies, employees, compliance deadlines, documents, notices and statutory work from one connected workspace.

items.title: Labour Compliance Firms
items.description: Standardize client workflows, assign responsibilities and give your team clear visibility across compliance work, documents and deadlines.

items.title: Payroll & Statutory Consultants
items.description: Process attendance and payroll with PF, ESI, PT, LWF, overtime, bonus and gratuity, then generate payslips and statutory outputs for each client.

items.title: Growing Consultancy Teams
items.description: Coordinate consultants and staff across a growing client portfolio with role-based access, tasks, reminders and centralized records.
